title: AM
description:
Located within an urban development in Gaia, this single-family house is set on a semi-detached plot, where one of the façades is constrained by adjoining construction. The primary challenge of the project was the design of a T4 dwelling organised on a single level, balancing functionality, natural light and spatial quality.

The ground floor is largely conceived as an open-plan space, promoting continuity between the living areas and the kitchen, oriented towards the street frontage and the side of the plot. In response to the client’s requirements and to optimise spatial efficiency, a partial mezzanine was introduced on the ground floor, positioned above the bedroom area, while the social spaces benefit from a more generous ceiling height.

The resulting volume draws inspiration from the calligraphy of the Scandinavian letter “A”, giving rise to a form that is both expressive and functional, defined by clarity of layout and an abundance of natural light.
